titulo_original: Not A Very Good Murderer/The Palladino Files Event

sinopsis.es: Avance de dos próximas series documentales de HBO: Ronan Farrow investiga la historia de una ex reina de belleza más extraña que la ficción, y rastrea el asesinato del legendario detective privado Jack Palladino.
sinopsis.en: A preview of two upcoming HBO documentary crime series: Ronan Farrow investigates a former beauty queen's stranger-than-fiction story, and traces the murder of legendary private eye Jack Palladino through his celebrity case files.
